ImageDescription.value:
The El Mocambo Tavern on Spadina is a popular Toronto watering hole, on Spadina Avenue.

The "El Mo" has been a fixture for live music in Toronto for over 100 years, and even hosted the Rolling Stones in the 1970s.

While the murals on the exterior are certainly interesting, the place is far more quiet by day.
